seo.title: 10-Day Morocco Itinerary | Marrakech, Fes, Sahara & Chefchaouen (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €980 pp. Definitive 10-day Morocco tour circuit (private VIP or group). Marrakech, High Atlas, Erg Chebbi Sahara camp, Fes medina, Chefchaouen & Casablanca.
seo.lead: The ultimate 10-day private Morocco expedition designed for travelers who want the complete spectrum of Morocco's geography and heritage. Beginning in Marrakech, this comprehensive route crosses the High Atlas, traverses the Sahara dunes of Erg Chebbi, explores the imperial medinas of Fes and Meknes, visits the blue mountain jewel of Chefchaouen, and concludes along the Atlantic coast in Rabat and Casablanca.

price.label: From EUR 980 per person
price.note: Price includes private air-conditioned transport for all 10 days, dedicated licensed driver-guide, 8 nights in curated boutique riads and hotels, 1 night in an Erg Chebbi luxury desert camp, guided historical tours in Marrakech and Fes, camel trek, dinners, and daily breakfasts.

seo.imageAlt: Grand Morocco circuit showcasing sweeping Sahara dunes, medieval imperial medinas, Atlas mountain passes, and Chefchaouen
highlights: Guided historical walking tour of Marrakech, including Bahia Palace, Koutoubia Mosque, and vibrant artisan souks
Scenic crossing of the High Atlas Mountains via Tizi n'Tichka pass (2,260m) and Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou
Sunset and sunrise camel trekking across the monumental golden dunes of Erg Chebbi in Merzouga
Full-day official guided cultural immersion in the ancient UNESCO-listed medina of Fes el-Bali
Leisurely discovery of Chefchaouen's world-famous cobalt-blue medina and panoramic mountain viewpoints
Cultural exploration of Roman Volubilis, imperial Meknes, Rabat's Hassan Tower, and Casablanca's Hassan II Mosque

faqs.question: What is the recommended start and end city for this 10-day grand circuit?
faqs.answer: This signature circuit is designed starting in Marrakech and concluding in Casablanca, which connects seamlessly with major international flights. However, the route can easily be operated in reverse or adjusted to start and end in the same city.

faqs.question: Are certified local guides provided in the imperial cities?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dedicated official licensed city guides are fully included for comprehensive half-day walking tours in both Marrakech and Fes, ensuring rich cultural, architectural, and historical understanding without getting lost in the souks.

faqs.question: How comfortable are the travel days across this 10-day itinerary?
faqs.answer: The itinerary is paced deliberately to allow 2-night stays in Marrakech and Fes, giving you time to breathe and explore without packing luggage every morning. Drives are conducted in late-model, climate-controlled vehicles with complimentary bottled water and Wi-Fi.

faqs.question: Can the accommodation categories be tailored to our budget?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer three tiers of curated Moroccan lodging: Authentic Heritage (charming traditional riads), Superior Comfort (deluxe boutique riads), and Luxury VIP (5-star palaces and luxury desert bivouacs with private plunge pools and heated suites).

faqs.question: What is the luggage allowance for this private circuit?
faqs.answer: Because transport is entirely private for your party, you have generous luggage space in the rear cargo area for full-size suitcases, garment bags, and daypacks.
